version.description: DESC-9. A single integer; there is no minor version. DESC-29 makes it count breaking changes to this Capability's own surface alone.

address.title: Address
address.description: DESC-12. An absolute https URL, or a relative reference resolved against the Descriptor's own URL. DESC-13 governs whether a credential may be sent to one that is off-origin.

title: Alerts capability entry
description: ALRT-1. The shared Capability entry with the address required. Nothing else: what a Worker raises an Alert about is its own business, so there is no catalog to declare.
